rationale: Selected eight founder-feasible, part-time-testable v1 records with concrete paid events and channel-led distribution, while preserving semantic variety. Commercial-archetype audit: the set contains field-service compliance SaaS (control9-02), a shared regulatory data utility (control9-03), a pre-border data gateway (control9-07), a regulated treatment-capacity exchange (rights9-09), an embedded transaction-assurance workflow (settle9-02), multi-sided clearing reconciliation middleware (settle9-04), a proof-to-pay network embedded in logistics finance (settle9-06), and a project payment-gate workflow (settle9-11); no archetype repeats. Control-point audit: the respective gates are a credential-checked service record/CRO update, DORA contract approval and register reporting, complete ENS data before border arrival, forward chemistry-matched recycler capacity, supplier-master or bank-change approval before payment, retailer approval of deposit-system settlements, shipment-invoice or factoring release, and contractor-draw/direct-payment evidence submission. These control different economic events rather than relabeling one compliance-document product. Critical-dependency audit: the portfolio separately tests rule translation into technician workflow, confidential contract extraction/entity resolution, multilingual upstream participation and filing-provider handoff, recycler capacity disclosure and reservation rights, official-registry/bank-result access, neutral access to POS/RVM/operator settlement data, TMS/factor distribution and signed delivery evidence, and authoritative project contracts/acceptance/payment proof. The dependencies span data rights, channel adoption, regulated capacity, interoperability, and counterparty cooperation rather than one common partner gate. Delayed-history review excluded control9-11 because its battery-passport custody structure closely repeats the indexed Managed Stationary-Battery Passport Custodian family; excluded settle9-12 because curtailment recovery/cooperative and claim-ledger variants are already indexed; and excluded rights9-03 because the recovered-refrigerant custody family is already present without enough proven structural distance. By contrast, settle9-06 advances beyond the indexed waiting-time proof-to-invoice concept by controlling full delivery-evidence readiness at factoring or invoice release, and settle9-11 advances beyond the indexed milestone-acceptance rail by binding downstream-payment proof to the public-works contractor draw. Absent conversion, access, and partner evidence remains uncertainty for research rather than a fatal selection filter.
